newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Andina confirms Coke offer.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Andina confirms Coke offer.

text.p: Chilean soft drinks bottler Embotelladora Andina said it has given The Coca-Cola Company the option to buy 18 million shares that remained unsuscribed from a recent capital increase.
Andina offered the shares to Coca-Cola for 2,264 pesos or about $5.45 each with payment to be made by February 21, said the company in a statement to Santiago's Electronic Stock Exchange.
Coca-Cola bought a seven percent stake in Andina for $140 million last year following a $250 million capital increase. The shares not bought by Coca-Cola were offered first to existing shareholders.
If consummated, the deal will boost Coca-Cola's stake in Andina to nearly 12 percent.
Andina is Chile's largest Coca-Cola bottler and has plants in Argentina and Brazil.
